project.name: Lazarus Dev commercial website
project.audience: Mahasiswa, pencari kerja, profesional muda dan pemilik UMKM
project.constraints: Native scrolling, no SVG, no new libraries or assets, no mobile overlap; prices, SOP, contacts and legal clauses remain accessible.

evidence.claim: Seven approved ordering stages with distinct actual inputs and deliverables, from package choice through live URL.
Six named sections: personal, design previews, business, order process, terms, contact.
evidence.source: Existing index.html plus this commercial gallery integration

selections.why: Seven real service stages each have a distinct input or output; the reader benefits from a compact persistent summary of the stage being read.
selections.readerBenefit: Understand which material, payment or deliverable is relevant without losing the full ordered SOP.
selections.implementation: Desktop-only CSS sticky typographic evidence panel; event-driven frame-coalesced DOM geometry selects the real SOP step; all steps always visible.
selections.stateSource: The ordered #alur .steps li elements and the viewport reading line; concise evidence labels sourced from each step.
selections.sourceDescription: Design OS 39c41d6528bfdf2005e3a29d2d37e8d0a71a493a Scroll Director registry and implementation recipes
selections.rejectionConsidered: No fabricated work-in-progress screenshot or animated illustration, no SVG path, no artificial scrolling distance.

fallback.noJs: Complete ordered SOP in normal flow; the supplemental sticky summary is hidden.
fallback.reducedMotion: Complete static SOP, without sticky panel or scroll-linked emphasis.
fallback.mobile: Complete inline numbered list, without persistent panel or overlay.

selections.why: Six substantive catalogue sections are long enough that desktop readers need a clear indication of their current section.
selections.readerBenefit: Find pricing, procedure, legal terms and contact without creating a second navigation branch.
selections.implementation: Existing single navigation receives aria-current=location from one active section; desktop sticky header only when sufficient width and height.
selections.stateSource: Ordered main section IDs and the same coalesced scroll snapshot; anchors remain native, no hash rewriting.
selections.sourceDescription: Design OS 39c41d6528bfdf2005e3a29d2d37e8d0a71a493a Scroll Director registry and implementation recipes
selections.rejectionConsidered: No extra progress rail or duplicate mobile navigation; the current existing menu is sufficient.

fallback.noJs: Normal header with working native fragment links and no sticky behavior.
fallback.reducedMotion: Active link updates discretely; no transition or persistent header.
fallback.mobile: Existing collapsible in-flow menu stays non-sticky; active section appears when opened.

rejected.reason: Previously reported stacked controls; overlap would risk hiding prices and form fields.
Existing artwork is static; extra layers add cost without improving package or process comprehension.
Owner explicitly rejected generic SVG; ordered SOP already communicates its sequence.
No verified frame sequence of actual client project delivery.

qa.environment: Pending GitHub Actions Chromium and independent visual/physical-phone review
